title: Missed-Appointment and Emergency Dispatch Charges: Waiver Rules of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Homeowner charges arising from appointments and emergency dispatches under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty are governed as follows. The program figures for missed appointments, the free missed appointments and the missed-appointment fee of each HomeCare program, remain those of the program's schedule of homeowner charges.

**Clauses no longer in force.**
- "Each missed appointment beyond the program's free missed appointments over the life of the home's coverage (counted including the one being recorded) carries the program's missed-appointment fee, linked to the claim item" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the missed-appointment charge.
- "An emergency dispatch that finds a condition caused by the homeowner or not covered carries the program's emergency dispatch fee" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the emergency dispatch charge.

**Waivers (in force).** A charge is waived only when the missed appointment followed a reschedule by Calloway on less than one business day's notice, and the waiver is recorded with waiver reason "Calloway rescheduled". A charge is waived at most once, and a charge already paid is not waived.

**Evidence.** Whether a charge has already been waived or paid is read from the coverage's own records of waivers and payments, matched by the charge number the waiver would name.

## Waiver truth table

| Missed appointment followed a Calloway reschedule on less than one business day's notice | Charge already waived | Charge already paid | Waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | May be waived, reason Calloway rescheduled |
| Yes | Yes | any | Not waived |
| Yes | any | Yes | Not waived |
| No | any | any | Not waived |

**Hypothetical illustration.** Calloway rescheduled an appointment on less than one business day's notice and the homeowner missed the rescheduled appointment; the resulting charge, unpaid and never waived, may be waived once with reason Calloway rescheduled. Had the homeowner already paid it, it would not be waived.

superseded_clauses: Each missed appointment beyond free_missed_appointments over the life of the home's coverage (warranty_msr_missed_appointments, counted including the one being recorded) carries missed_appointment_fee_usd, linked to the claim item.
An emergency dispatch that finds a condition caused by the homeowner or not covered carries emergency_dispatch_fee_usd.
